sections.name: Beer
items: A classic Belgian lager, golden in color with exceptional clarity and a spicy hop character.

100% barley malt, choice hops and pure water give this brew unsurpassed clarity.

Hops, hops and more hops. This beer is brewed using only the finest US grown hops from our good friends out West.
Cerveza Pacífico Clara, better known as Pacífico, is a Mexican pilsner-style beer named after the Pacífico brewery located in the Pacific Ocean port city of Mazatlán, in Sinaloa, México.
Brewed with oats for creaminess and spiced with the perfect combination of orange peel for subtle sweetness.
Grupo says it is a Pilsner, through RB states it is a Pale Lager and BA a American Adjunct Lager.
Negra Modelo was first brewed in Mexico by Austrian immigrants, and was introduced as a draft beer in 1926.
